apps.name: Religion inc. God Simulator (Paid App)
apps.localizedDescription:
Casual-strategy Sandbox game about Gods, Civilisations and Faith!
There are many religions in the world, each shaped in its own way. But how else could this process have evolved? What interesting manners and customs forms could human beliefs take? The answers are waiting for you in the game!

Features of Religion Inc. God Simulator:
• Discover diverse archetypes of religions and cults as you play: monotheism, spiritualism, pantheon, shamanism, paganism, and many more!
• Thousands of religious aspects — with even more coming in future updates!
• Unique active abilities — perform miracles!
• Various story events unfolding throughout the game!
• Offline mode: play without an internet connection.
• Game modes: sandbox, endle
